purpose: Create complete freeform characters with retained construction, optional explicit skeletons, reusable skin bindings and animation clips.

properties.path: target .glb file outside the protected live machine body
properties.recipe: axm.character-recipe/v0.1 with form body, optional axm.character-rig/v0.1 rig and explicit animation clips

contains: complete character GLB, static or explicitly skinned and animated
material intent and response binding status
sibling creator-source sidecar with exact recipe and compiled geometry

relationships: treats race as body/look structure rather than a character class
lets unusual body families declare their own clothing regions instead of pretending every garment fits every race
keeps an entire character's construction structure available for later reshaping and reuse
executes declared skeleton/skin/clip construction without inferring anatomy or motion
limitations: Rest skeleton uses parent-local translation with identity rotation and scale; animation supports translation and unit quaternion rotation with LINEAR/STEP interpolation.

Bindings support rigid parts, explicit four-influence vertex weights, and declared axis-blend fields. No automatic skeleton inference, anatomical weighting, IK, retargeting, cloth or corrective deformation.
Declared clothing regions are compatibility metadata, not proof that a garment fits without clipping.
Material response intent can be retained even when the current renderer has not earned a response-organ binding receipt.
Visual similarity, character appeal and target-engine gameplay remain separate evidence gates.
